title: Smoothness and etaleness near a Noetherian closed subspace are detected on its infinitesimal neighbourhoods
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For f : X -> Y locally of finite type with Y locally Noetherian and Z ⊂ Y closed with nth infinitesimal neighbourhoods Z_n, X_n = Z_n x_Y X: if every X_n -> Z_n is smooth then f is smooth along f^{-1}(Z); if every X_n -> Z_n is etale then f is etale along f^{-1}(Z). The retained proof is complete via the Artinian lifting criterion: at x over Z, a small extension B' -> B with the test diagram of the chapter's lifting-along-artinian-at-point lemma has nilpotent maximal ideal (B' Artinian), so the structure map beta factors through some Z_n and alpha through the corresponding X_n; the hypothesized lifting property of X_n -> Z_n supplies the dotted arrow, proving smoothness at x. Part (2) is (1) plus the etale = smooth of relative dimension zero characterization. Retained author proof at lines 5245-5256.
